d:
US equity futures drop as questions mount over the outlook for the AI trade, while Treasuries rally ahead of the latest PCE data. China calls the prospect of new US tariffs on its exports “political maneuvering” and urges both sides to maintain their trade truce. Max Kettner of HSBC joins "Bloomberg Brief" to discuss the tech selloff and looks ahead to the inflation reading.
